scope: Global FAQ / buyer-objection page — trust and sales-conversion page that answers pre-demo clinic-buyer questions at the claim ceiling of the destination pages; it is not a capability, feature or workflow page and introduces no new product claim

seo.title: پرسش‌های متداول درباره CPMS | برای مدیران کلینیک
seo.description_source: WordPress page excerpt via existing Koorosh mechanism
seo.intent: Objection/evaluation intent only (SITE-ARCHITECTURE §5.2 FAQ row). It does not own the Cluster-1 clinic-software head terms, contains no «بهترین» self-award and no competitor comparison (SEO-KEYWORD-MAP §D / Cluster 9), and carries no keyword stuffing. Natural supporting terms around پرسش‌های متداول / تناسب با کلینیک / محدودهٔ قابلیت‌ها only.

structured_data: NONE — deliberately omitted. Google Search Central officially deprecated the FAQ rich result (May 2026: «Deprecating the FAQ rich result feature») and removed its documentation (June 2026: «Removing documentation for the FAQ rich result feature»); unused structured data has no visible Search effect. No JSON-LD, no FAQPage, no microdata is emitted on this page, and a guardrail enforces that. Repository policy (SITE-ARCHITECTURE §5.3) additionally defers structured data to the Hardening phase and performs no indexing work while the site is intentionally non-indexed.
layout: Open question/answer layout — deliberately NOT an accordion. Answers are readable and crawlable without interaction, no <details>/toggle/script exists on the page, questions are H3 and answers are reading-size paragraphs.

question_model.themes_and_counts: شناخت CPMS و تناسب با کلینیک (4) / جریان‌های کاری و محدودهٔ قابلیت‌ها (5) / داده، دسترسی و ادعاهای امنیتی (2) / ارزیابی، دمو و مسیر تصمیم (3)
boundary_answers: full accounting not claimed (bounded manual payment recording and financial summaries only)
national Iranian e-prescription connection not claimed
AI not claimed (no clinical decision support or automatic diagnosis suggestion)
no security certificate, compliance claim or absolute guarantee
question_model.redirect_rule: Every boundary answer ends by pointing at what can be evaluated in the demo or the offered version; a guardrail also caps negated clauses so the page cannot become a disclaimer wall.

pricing: Public/fixed pricing NOT decided and NOT published. The answer states only that no fixed public price is announced and that the current sales path is needs review plus consultation — no figure, package, tier, subscription, per-user model, discount or comparison.
conversion: Primary CTA routes to the real /demo/ page (hero and final panel). Assisted-sale only; no pricing commitment, checkout or instant-signup promise.
lead_delivery: NOT CONFIGURED / NOT AUTHORIZED — the page states honestly (in the request-path answer and once in the final panel) that the current request path does not reach Sales and that no information is sent or stored.
navigation: Footer discovery only, through the canonical WordPress-native footer menu (reconstruction/site-shell/menu.mjs); the primary navigation is unchanged and FAQ is not a new top-level header item.
media: None. Accepted product-media reservations already exist elsewhere; this page deliberately adds no media frame, icon, stock image or decorative card.
launch_blockers: Live lead delivery must be configured and authorized
Every answer must be re-verified against launch product evidence at the Launch Truth Gate
